Class Reservation

java.lang.Object
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.util.List<Booking>
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.fleet.Reservation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Booking>
public class Reservation extends List<Booking>
This class creates an array of bookings, where if the array is full adds 4 more spaces to the array Then, additional lines of description are added to elaborate on the details if necessary.
